title: The current status of each shipment from a stream of scans
examObjective: Applying correct syntax to write DataWeave transformations to coerce, format, order, and filter data
basics: `orderBy` sorts an Array by a key. There is no descending flag; to reverse a sorted Array, select it with `[-1 to 0]`. `distinctBy` keeps the first element it sees for each key.
prompt:
The carrier sends scan events `{ shipment, status, at }`, where `at` is an ISO UTC timestamp. Events for one shipment can arrive out of order.

Return one `{ shipment, status }` per shipment, holding the status of its **latest** scan, ordered by shipment id.
hints: `distinctBy $.shipment` keeps one scan per shipment, but which one does it keep?
It keeps the first one it meets. Make sure the first one it meets is the latest.
Sort by `at`, reverse, then `distinctBy`, then sort by shipment. ISO UTC timestamps sort correctly as text.
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
((payload orderBy $.at)[-1 to 0] distinctBy $.shipment orderBy $.shipment) map { shipment: $.shipment, status: $.status } default []

mustFail.why: deduplicates in arrival order, so it keeps whichever scan arrived first, not the latest
mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
(payload distinctBy $.shipment orderBy $.shipment) map { shipment: $.shipment, status: $.status }

mustFail.why: sorts oldest first before deduplicating, so it keeps the earliest scan
mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
((payload orderBy $.at) distinctBy $.shipment orderBy $.shipment) map { shipment: $.shipment, status: $.status } default []

mustFail.why: is right whenever there are scans, but reversing an empty array gives null, so a quiet day returns null instead of []
mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
((payload orderBy $.at)[-1 to 0] distinctBy $.shipment orderBy $.shipment) map { shipment: $.shipment, status: $.status }

explanation.approach: `distinctBy` keeps the first element for each key, so "latest" has to be made "first" before it runs: sort by time, then reverse. The sample has one scan per shipment, which hides that entirely. One more edge: `[-1 to 0]` on an empty array is null, so a day with no scans needs `default []`.

snippets.label: Reversing an empty array
snippets.note: There is no element -1 to start from.
